events.title: Thank you, and what comes next: seasons included in the game
events.summary: Hello everyone, Since the demo came out, more and more of you have been following Dynamic Breach, playing it and writing to me. I make this game alone, and every wishlist counts: thank you. What comes next: seasons, included in the game Requiem, the campaign that releases on November 2, is complete: 33 operations, with endings that depend on your choices. But it is only the beginning. events.title: In Steam Next Fest until October 26
events.summary: Dynamic Breach is in Steam Next Fest, from October 19 to October 26. The demo is free on the store page for the whole festival: a top-down tactical shooter, gothic-military and necro-technological, in which you command a squad of AI allies, and every mode can be played solo, offline, against bots. You have a lot of demos to get through, so here is the short version. events.title: The demo is available now
events.summary: The Dynamic Breach demo is on the store page now, free. It covers the five operations of the prologue and the Breach versus mode against bots. Dynamic Breach is a top-down tactical shooter, gothic-military and necro-technological: you command a squad of AI allies, and every mode can be played solo, offline, against bots.
